description: SC-ACIS—Applied Climate Information System is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Cornell University Northeast Regional Climate Center; American Association of State Climatologists; NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. This system provides access to daily climate data from U.S. weather stations in the Global Historical Climate Network and other networks. Products include climate normals, daily almanac, first/last dates, graphs, and daily and monthly summaries of temperature, precipitation, snowfall, snow depth, and degree days. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat. Assets: Energy and Utilities, People, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
